01.label: The full dashboard after transfer
01.try: Open the complete 20-chart Individual Data dashboard with an explicit reporting window.
01.expected: All 20 charts are present and the opening hospital has useful content in every panel. SQL, calculated columns, layout and filter bindings match the versioned package.
01.videoIntro: The April dashboard is imported into a separate instance with different chart IDs. This walkthrough shows the complete dashboard after the import checks pass.
01.videoOutro: The full dashboard is preserved. On 6.1.0, the deployment helper repairs cached filter references; the snapshot remaps those references natively.

02.label: Month, Quarter and Year labels
02.try: Change Time Unit while keeping the reporting dates fixed.
02.expected: Date axes and hover details use Jan 2025, Q1 2025 and 2025. Both endpoints remain visible, with spaced intermediate labels and chronological dates.
02.videoIntro: Use the same reporting window with three grouping choices. The CSiM formatter follows the selected unit on the trend charts and the lower date axes.
02.videoOutro: The formatter changes presentation without converting dates into text. All eleven date axes are checked when they contain data.

03.label: Missing periods and selected dates
03.try: Inspect hospital 91, then narrow the window to February–March and group by Quarter.
03.expected: February is missing, March is a valid zero, and February–March has 10 submissions without January.
03.videoIntro: Known test records make these differences visible: no February submissions, a valid zero rate in March, and a partial-quarter window.
03.videoOutro: Calendar rows retain missing months. The date window filters observations before grouping, and an empty selection can return to a populated result on the same page.

04.label: Change and clear dashboard filters
04.try: Set Time Period and Time Unit in either order, then clear and reselect.
04.expected: Equivalent selections return equivalent results. The dashboard recovers without a page reload.
04.videoIntro: Time Period selects observations; Time Unit groups them. This workflow checks both selection orders and recovery after Clear all.
04.videoOutro: Both orders produce the same results. Reselecting the filters restores the charts on the same page. Historical intermittent authoring and navigation reports remain separate.

05.label: Time Unit choices
05.try: Inspect the saved Time Unit menus for this installation.
05.expected: Main: Month/Quarter/Year is an instance-wide workaround. Snapshot: CSiM and hourly reporting save independent menus.
05.videoIntro: The released build restricts choices across the whole instance. The pinned development snapshot supports independent saved choices for each dashboard.
05.videoOutro: The distinction is a Superset version capability. The main build retains the global workaround; the snapshot demonstrates the native per-dashboard feature.

06.label: Two series across a year boundary
06.try: Compare hospitals 91 and 92 in Month, Quarter and Year views.
06.expected: Both series remain ordered across 2025–2026, with readable date labels.
06.videoIntro: Text dates can sort incorrectly when a chart compares multiple series. These charts retain real dates and format the labels separately.
06.videoOutro: The two series remain chronological. Labels keep the first and last period visible, with enough space at the graph edges.

07.label: From month, Through month and Group by
07.try: Choose February through March, then compare Quarter and Year. Clear and reselect the months.
07.expected: Both endpoints are inclusive. Q1 contains February and March only; invalid ranges cannot be applied, and clearing recovers on the same page.

08.label: Beth’s September additions with familiar controls
08.try: Open the September version, inspect the latest-data card, keep your date selections when jumping to sections, and choose the lower comparison groups.
08.expected: All 21 charts are present. The latest reporting month remains independent of the viewing window. Section links keep filters, and comparison selectors separate hospitals from named groups.
08.videoIntro: The September version includes Beth’s latest-data card, explanations and layout. The established 20-chart dashboard remains available for comparison.
08.videoOutro: The new version keeps the date and filter corrections with Beth’s additions. The established dashboard remains unchanged.

09.label: Cohort opening and hospital totals
09.try: Open the full September dashboard, select Your hospital, then clear and reselect it.
09.expected: Cohort results open immediately. Hospital-only panels give selection guidance until a hospital is chosen. Clearing never substitutes an all-hospital total.
09.videoIntro: The main charts start with Cohort. Use the separate Your hospital selection for the lower comparison charts and all-time submission card.
09.videoOutro: Hospital 53 has 980 eligible all-time submissions in this supplied demo. Clearing restores the selection prompt; reselecting restores its total on the same page.

10.label: Official Superset: controls and date labels
10.try: Compare Month, Quarter and Year, then select February and March using the native Time Period editor.
10.expected: The native candidate displays chronological year-first labels and filters before grouping. Its date editor uses an exclusive end date; dedicated inclusive month fields are not present.
10.videoIntro: This full September dashboard uses official Superset 6.1.0 without CSiM application patches. Review the native controls and the differences from the requested workflow.
10.videoOutro: Official Superset preserves the selected observations and chronological grouping. This candidate uses year-first labels and a date-range editor; those differences remain open acceptance choices.

11.label: From and Through month in official Superset
11.try: Select November through April, then narrow to February–March and change Month to Quarter and Year.
11.expected: Both endpoints are included. February has no observations, March is a valid zero, and the partial quarter and year each contain 10 submissions without January.
11.videoIntro: Ordinary Superset dropdowns select inclusive From and Through months. The separate Time Unit changes grouping; the dashboard uses year-first labels.
11.videoOutro: Inclusive month filtering works without CSiM application patches. This option uses horizontal filters and fixed saved defaults; exact month and quarter wording remains different.
